title: InferredArrayTupleDraft7
description: Issue #166 in the tuple spelling drafts 4 to 7 use: `items` as an array of schemas, with `additionalItems` governing everything past it. Both took the same reduction as the 2020-12 prefixItems form -- each position kept its declared JSON type and dropped the rest -- and neither is reachable from a 2020-12 document, so the draft matters.

tup.$comment: No "type":"array", so this is the inferred array. Position 0 names a shape and so does the tail.

one.$comment: The single-schema form under the same dialect.
